title: A Grand View | Santa Rosa Beach, FL | Five Star Properties

description_expanded: A Grand View – Stunning Gulf Views & Direct Beach Access Favorite Features: - Beachfront - Private Beach Access - Bikes Included - Complimentary Beach Service (In-Season) About A Grand View: Welcome to the ultimate Gulf-front retreat in beautiful Santa Rosa Beach, where every detail has been thoughtfully curated to elevate your beach vacation experience. Nestled along a private road on the peaceful west end of Scenic Highway 30A, this exceptional beachfront home offers sweeping, unobstructed views of the emerald waters and sugar-white sands that make this coastline world-famous. Step inside and be greeted by bright, light-filled living spaces that are both welcoming and stylish. With four comfortable bedrooms and three well-appointed bathrooms, this home offers space and privacy for families, friends, or multi-family vacations. Vaulted ceilings and a soothing coastal palette enhance the relaxed, beach-house atmosphere, while multiple living areas make it easy to unwind after a day of sun and surf. The open-concept kitchen and dining area serve as the heart of the home — ideal for shared meals, morning coffee, and evening gatherings. A sleek wet bar adds an extra touch of sophistication, perfect for mixing up sunset cocktails as you watch the sky change colors over the Gulf. When it’s time to take in the outdoors, this property truly shines. Step out onto the wide covered porch with direct Gulf views — the perfect place to enjoy your first cup of coffee or relax with a good book. A dune-side covered deck brings you even closer to the shoreline, creating an idyllic setting for morning stretches, sunset chats, or quiet nights under the stars. Located in one of 30A’s most coveted and peaceful stretches, you’ll enjoy the tranquility of beachfront living while still being just minutes from local favorites like signature 30A restaurants, boutique shopping, bike paths, and outdoor activities. Whether you want to explore nearby Scenic Highway 30A towns or simply lounge and soak up the sun, this home serves as the perfect launch point for a memorable Florida vacation.
